rows.label: Aya
rows.note: rough relic budget; carries over forever
rows.alt: Deimos Tier 5 bounties or syndicate relic packs

conditions: Pyrana Prime is vaulted and is not currently in Prime Resurgence, so no relevant relic can be earned or bought for Aya until its rotation returns.
bonuses: Volt speeds the escort drone and rescue target; Nova's Wormhole can move a drone. Titania is strong for pure traversal.

disclosures.title: the calendar is the gate
disclosures.body: Varzia changes stock every 28 days at 18:00 UTC. Check her Next Offering before acting: Prime Resurgence order is not predictable, and missing a Pyrana window can mean a long wait.

rows.label: Meso P6 or Lith P7
rows.alt: old vaulted Blueprint relics also work

rows.label: Lith L3 or Neo A9
rows.alt: old vaulted Barrel relics also work

rows.label: Axi D3 or Lith D5
rows.alt: old vaulted Receiver relics also work

conditions: The Limbo/Trinity rotation sold Meso P6, Lith L3, and Axi D3. The Limbo/Mesa rotation sold Lith P7, Neo A9, and Lith D5. Confirm the actual current IDs in Varzia's shop.
Relics bought during Prime Resurgence are tradeable and never expire. Stockpile during the window, then crack them whenever you are ready.
If you already own old relics, the Blueprint is in Axi P1/P2/P3, Lith P1/P2/P7, or Meso P1/P6; Barrel and Receiver have additional old-relic sources.
bonuses: Varzia is also available from the Orbiter Relic Segment and the Prime Resurgence Market tab.
A tradeable completed set is the alternative if waiting on the rotation or farming Aya is not worthwhile.

rows.label: Pyrana Prime Blueprint
rows.note: Meso P6 or Lith P7, Rare: 10% Radiant

rows.label: Pyrana Prime Barrel
rows.note: Lith L3 or Neo A9, Common: run Intact

rows.label: Pyrana Prime Receiver
rows.note: Axi D3 or Lith D5, Uncommon: 20% Radiant

conditions: Refine the Blueprint and Receiver relics to Radiant (100 Void Traces). Four matching Radiant relics give a 34.39% chance of at least one Rare reward per run.
Keep the Barrel relic Intact: refining reduces its Common chance. Use a dedicated vaulted-relic radshare, not a public fissure with mismatched relics.
Collect 10 Reactant before extraction. Fast full-squad Capture or Exterminate fissures are efficient; Void Cascade is a slower but lower-reset alternative.
bonuses: Farm Void Traces on current fissures before the vaulted batch; buying 5 Traces for 1 Aya from Varzia is a poor exchange.
Choose another player's duplicate reward whenever it appears; you retain the item and they receive bonus Void Traces.

disclosures.title: verify the radshare
disclosures.body: A squadmate can silently bring the wrong relic. Confirm the relic name and refinement before every run; one unmatched relic materially reduces the gold-slot odds.

rows.label: Pyrana Prime
rows.note: 15,000 cr, 1 Orokin Cell, Blueprint, Barrel, Receiver

conditions: Crafting needs Mastery Rank 13 and takes 12 hours. Keep a free secondary weapon slot for the claim.
bonuses: Buying the finished weapon from Varzia with Regal Aya bypasses the MR requirement.
